t: Unveiling the Mind-Blowing Biotech of Regeneration: Michael Levin

q.x: Highly recommend checking out more of Michael Levin's work beyond just xenobots, it's very exciting stuff. I found this to be a pretty entertaining, pop-sci digestible entry point to listen to (includes a section discussing the xenobots stuff as well): [link]
